meta.name: baoyu-markdown-to-html
meta.description: Converts Markdown to styled HTML with WeChat-compatible themes. Supports code highlighting, math, PlantUML, footnotes, alerts, and infographics. Use when user asks for "markdown to html", "convert md to html", "md转html", or needs styled HTML output from markdown.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Markdown 转为带微信主题的 HTML
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把 Markdown 文档转成微信兼容的 HTML
copy.tagline_en: Convert Markdown to styled HTML with WeChat themes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often convert Markdown to WeChat-compatible HTML

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能将 Markdown 文件转换为带样式的 HTML，支持代码高亮、数学公式、图表、脚注、提示框等，并适配微信公众号等平台。
howto.when: 当你要求“把 Markdown 转成 HTML”、“md 转 html”或需要从 Markdown 生成带样式的 HTML 时触发。

say.text: 把这篇 Markdown 文章转成 HTML，用优雅主题。
say.note: Claude 会确认主题并执行转换。

say.text: 将 article.md 转为 HTML，保留标题。
say.note: Claude 会使用默认主题并保留第一个标题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can convert Markdown files to styled HTML with inline CSS, supporting code highlighting, math, PlantUML, footnotes, alerts, and infographics, optimized for WeChat Official Account and other platforms.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "convert Markdown to HTML", "md to html", or need styled HTML output from Markdown.

say_en.text: Convert this Markdown article to HTML using the grace theme.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm the theme and perform the conversion.

say_en.text: Convert article.md to HTML and keep the title.
say_en.note: Claude will use the default theme and keep the first heading.
